body: Doing something completely differently can feel surprisingly natural, especially when your default response has been manufacturing the exact same frustration on a loop. When the Moon trines Uranus, emotion and sudden shifts cooperate, making it frictionless to break a habit, alter a routine, or answer someone in a way that preserves your freedom without turning the experiment into a dramatic life declaration. You may discover you never needed as much permission as you thought to rewrite your own script. Keep the change that actually makes the room breathe.
